arguments.value: Pediatric pacing case series describing two infants with congenital atrioventricular block managed with pacemaker implantation. One patient developed successful transvenous endocardial RV septal pacing with stable long-term lead function, while the other required conversion from epicardial to endocardial pacing after epicardial lead failure and battery depletion. The report reviews selection of pacing strategy, technical considerations in small children, and long-term follow-up outcomes.
